long_biography.plain_text:
Downtown Doral gave Armando Codina the opportunity to develop a whole neighbourhood around daily life. Alongside homes, offices and shops, it includes a city hall and two multilingual charter schools. He and his daughter Ana-Marie treated education and public space as reasons for families to settle there.

Keeping development close to home also had a personal purpose: Codina wanted to see his mother for lunch each day. Ana-Marie brought an MIT business education to their partnership. He supplied the capital for their property firm; she became chief executive, handling its broader responsibilities while he selected the projects he most wanted to pursue.
